Are you ready to go electric? Add serious power to your existing Non-Electric MADSEN bike! With the same quality and attention to detail you expect from MADSEN, our custom 750-watt mid-drive electric assist kit will massively up your bucket bike game!

This kit is designed exclusively for the MADSEN bucket bike, with custom wiring, programming, and a precision mounting bracket. By choosing the MADSEN kit (instead of an off-market option), you get more than just a motor—you get a system tested and engineered specifically for your bike, using the mounts already built into the frame. Plus, installing the MADSEN kit preserves your bike's warranty. You’ll love its sleek look and seamless fit.

With e-assist, you can tap into power exactly when you need it. This upgrade has exceeded our expectations and has been a game-changer for many riders. Get ready to enjoy your MADSEN even more—carry heavier cargo, tackle hills with ease, and extend your adventures. It’s incredible!

Love my new e-assist

I was already in love with my Madsen but adding the e-assist has made it so much better. We now can pack it full of picnic supplies and bike to farflung parks for dinner. My daughter loves going “weeee” when the motor kick in.
The e-assist is truly amazing! Thanks for the review, Matthew! And cheers to many more bucket bike adventures - and longer distances :). Thanks for being here!
Amazing upgrade, totally worth it

We bought our Madsen 3 years ago without the e-assist kit. It's perfectly usable but can be challenging to pedal depending on cargo and distance. The e-assist kit changed all that! We got our local bike shop to install it for a resonable fee - they were initially skeptical but the installation video gave them confidence and is an awesome resource to understand how the install has to be done. Still, ask your local shop because some might be reluctant to install an aftermarket kit for you. The e-assist makes the Madsen feel lighter and makes pedaling effortless. Still, it can be adjusted to still provide some resistance if you're looking for a workout. Most of the time that's how I use it, at the lowest assist levels. But it's good to know the extra power is available if I get too tired. The added weight is still there and under no power, the bike does feel heavier to pedal, though I like that it *can* move under pedal power only, handy in case of dead battery or motor issues. I lowered the speed limiter to 24 km/h since out of the box it has a much higher limit and it felt a bit dangerous particularly when carrying kids. All in all it's a great upgrade that really increases our range and makes the Madsen even more suitable to replace a car for the vast majority of our needs, allowing us to use it more frequently and for more things. Perhaps my only regret is that I didn't splurge on the e-assist when I first got the bike :)
It's got punch!
This is my second electric bike. Although I'm not a huge fan of the mechanics, it's a powerful engine and it's my fastest bike. It's fun!
Thanks for the review, Abigail! So thrilled to hear you are loving the bike and its speed! Cheers to many bucket bike adventures ahead.

The new disk break on our newest model, the Dutch handles and seat and the settings on the e assist makes for quite the comfortable ride. We use our 2 Madsen Bikes all the time! To baseball games, neighborhood outings, beach vacations, road trips. It is unbeatable when it comes to the beach- we fill one bucket with all the beach loot and the other with our 5 kids and ride right up to the beach front and set up- talk about VIP parking (that is free)!! We used it when we parked to see Hoover Dam on one of our road trips thinking - would we rather have our kids walk half a mile up a hill coming back or ride in the bike? No brainer… biking to 4th of July fireworks and not worrying about finding a parking spot, decorating the bike for the parade. It really has been one of our funnest purchases for family memories. Feel like you need extra security for your MADSEN? Each MADSEN comes already equipped with the awesome Dutch Rim Lock and 2 keys. To add additional security, this Cable Lock clicks right into the Rim Lock and works with the same keys as the Rim Lock. Now you can secure your bike around something else ... like a bike rack or a tree. Keep your MADSEN safe.
Awesome Lock
Easy to use and a nice length. I really love this lock when I'm running a quick errand or locking up in view. It feels pretty secure as long as you're not in a high to theft area.
Thank you for the review, Mead! We are glad that you can feel more confident in taking your MADSEN out!
Great lock

I do find that it can come loose when I open and close the lock, so you just have to make sure it’s secure when you’re unlocking the wheel lock. I’m still not ready to leave my Madsen unattended for long periods of time, but it is very convenient to have the wheel lock and the chain lock.
Cable lock -- works great

I bought the cable lock a couple of months ago.The Madsen rim lock is great, but a thief could still try to grab the bike, throw it in a truck, and make a quick getaway. The cable works very well with the rim lock. I can run the cable around a pole as well as through my seat leash. To be clear, I still use a hefty U-lock and thick cable when I have to park my Madsen on the street for any decent length of time. But the cable, paired with the rim lock, offers some peace of mind in less-risky situations.

content.text: Bikes Ship Assembled & Tuned Up — Ready to Ride
MADSEN DK2 Bikes
Free Shipping in the Continental U.S.*
Ready For Anything
EASE OF USE

Unlike other cargo bikes, the MADSEN bucket bike comes fully equipped—no extra accessories, straps, or bags needed—making it a more affordable option. With its extra large cargo capacity , it's so easy to just toss your cargo in the bucket and go! Bikes are available with electric assist, giving you extra power when you need it.
SAFETY

On a MADSEN, the rider approaches traffic first, with kids safely behind you . The ultra-tough bucket features two removable bench seats and four seat belts to keep little ones secure. A middle seat is also available for added versatility. MADSEN is its known for stability and smart weight distribution .
ATTENTION TO DETAIL

Since 2007 , MADSEN has been perfecting the ultimate cargo bike . Unlike many brands that simply resell bikes, MADSEN designs and refines every detail in-house. The new DK2 model features a stunning OG flat-top biplane crown and sleek internal cable routing. All bikes include an integrated front wheel lock, thru-axle hubs, and MADSEN’s patented heavy-duty kickstand™ for safe, easy loading.
WORKHORSE BICYCLE

Tested to carry 271kg (600lb) of weight, the MADSEN is not just beautiful , but notably rugged and tough. Because our bikes are built to last , your kids will never outgrow its capability—making it the only cargo bike you’ll ever need. The possibilities are endless. Whether you're carrying kids, groceries, pets, or gear, the MADSEN is up for any task.
A Fun, Unique Bike for the Family

Classic, fun-colored electric cargo bikes that can carry up to four kids plus all the gear, MADSEN Cycles puts the perfect twist on family bikes. It rides like a regular bike and puts your cargo safely behind you. We hope your whole family falls in love with your new bucket bike — as so many other families have!
Room for the whole family
Choose from one of our 7 bike colors. You can't go wrong—they are all THAT good! Bike and bucket colors can be mixed and matched to create a custom look that meets your style.
Must have accessories

Complete the look and utility of your ride with thoughtfully designed accessories we love. Choose the " Premium " package to include some of our most popular accessories—or go all-in with the " Luxury " package, which includes (almost) everything. All of our Electric Bikes come equipped with the custom MADSEN Electric Assist system, giving you extra power when you want it.
A Bicycle Can Do More

Jared Madsen is the founder and designer of MADSEN Cycles, the Utah-based family business that launched the now-iconic “bucket” cargo bike in 2008 with the belief that a bicycle can do more . Guided by his philosophy that there’s always a better way , Jared has continued to refine and improve his unique family bucket bike.

content.text: Bikes Ship Assembled & Tuned Up — Ready to Ride
MADSEN DK2 Bikes
Free Shipping in the Continental U.S.*
Ready For Anything
EASE OF USE

Unlike other cargo bikes, the MADSEN bucket bike comes fully equipped—no extra accessories, straps, or bags needed—making it a more affordable option. With its extra large cargo capacity , it's so easy to just toss your cargo in the bucket and go! Bikes are available with electric assist, giving you extra power when you need it.
SAFETY

On a MADSEN, the rider approaches traffic first, with kids safely behind you . The ultra-tough bucket features two removable bench seats and four seat belts to keep little ones secure. A middle seat is also available for added versatility. MADSEN is its known for stability and smart weight distribution .
ATTENTION TO DETAIL

Since 2007 , MADSEN has been perfecting the ultimate cargo bike . Unlike many brands that simply resell bikes, MADSEN designs and refines every detail in-house. The new DK2 model features a stunning OG flat-top biplane crown and sleek internal cable routing. All bikes include an integrated front wheel lock, thru-axle hubs, and MADSEN’s patented heavy-duty kickstand™ for safe, easy loading.
WORKHORSE BICYCLE

Tested to carry 271kg (600lb) of weight, the MADSEN is not just beautiful , but notably rugged and tough. Because our bikes are built to last , your kids will never outgrow its capability—making it the only cargo bike you’ll ever need. The possibilities are endless. Whether you're carrying kids, groceries, pets, or gear, the MADSEN is up for any task.
A Fun, Unique Bike for the Family

Classic, fun-colored electric cargo bikes that can carry up to four kids plus all the gear, MADSEN Cycles puts the perfect twist on family bikes. It rides like a regular bike and puts your cargo safely behind you. We hope your whole family falls in love with your new bucket bike — as so many other families have!
Room for the whole family
Choose from one of our 7 bike colors. You can't go wrong—they are all THAT good! Bike and bucket colors can be mixed and matched to create a custom look that meets your style.
Must have accessories

Complete the look and utility of your ride with thoughtfully designed accessories we love. Choose the " Premium " package to include some of our most popular accessories—or go all-in with the " Luxury " package, which includes (almost) everything. All of our Electric Bikes come equipped with the custom MADSEN Electric Assist system, giving you extra power when you want it.
A Bicycle Can Do More

Jared Madsen is the founder and designer of MADSEN Cycles, the Utah-based family business that launched the now-iconic “bucket” cargo bike in 2008 with the belief that a bicycle can do more . Guided by his philosophy that there’s always a better way , Jared has continued to refine and improve his unique family bucket bike.

Our custom Mælkekasse is handcrafted by Jared Madsen and inspired by his father and uncle, Even and Dan, and their Danish delivery bikes from the 1940s.

As young boys, they delivered groceries and supplies between Aalborg and surrounding towns. Their grandfather owned a dairy farm called ENKILDEGAARD , where old milk canisters were recently discovered—sparking the idea for this beautiful, front-rack crate.
The Mælkekasse (milk cream crate) is thoughtfully designed and hand-built by Jared in the MADSEN shop using upcycled wood. It’s custom-tooled to fit your front rack perfectly.

OUR STORY
Hi, we are the Madsens—Jared, Lisa, Evan, Cooper, Meg, and our dogs, Opal and Jade.
MADSEN Cycles started with a passion for bicycles, a talent for design, and an entrepreneurial spirit. From the beginning, we believed a bicycle could be so much more.

Jared’s journey began at age 15 when he started working in a bike shop, driven by a childhood love of bicycles. Despite the challenges of dyslexia , his natural talent for mechanics and art fueled his success in building and creating. As a teenager, he restored old Toyota Land Cruisers to earn extra cash, setting the foundation for his path in mechanical design. Eventually, he worked at various companies designing arcade machines, motorized scooters, and ATVs, gaining valuable experience in manufacturing, engineering, and product development.

Jared’s father emigrated from Denmark at 17, bringing deep Danish roots that have shaped our family’s traditions, values, and love for bicycles. We recently reconnected with family in Aalborg, Denmark, where relatives still own the family farm where Grandpa once worked.

In 2007, a trip to the Netherlands inspired us to make cycling more accessible to families. Impressed by Europe’s cargo bikes, Jared set out to design one better suited for the U.S. market—blending inspiration from his travels with our Danish heritage.

Working from our garage in 2007-2008, Jared developed multiple prototypes, ultimately creating the 'bucket bike'—a rear cargo bike designed for easy riding, tackling hills, and ensuring safety. Built to carry up to 600 lbs, our bikes comfortably fit four kids, pets, and all their gear. Jared's goal was to create a bike that kids wouldn’t grow out of, making it the only cargo bike families would ever need—and one that lasts.

That same year, with our kids still little, we launched our small business. It was a bold venture filled with blood, sweat, and tears, but it has been an incredibly rewarding journey. Today, thousands of families across the U.S., Canada, and Europe are making memories on MADSEN bikes.

Jared’s dedication to detail and demand for design perfection, paired with Lisa’s love for customer connections, has shaped MADSEN Cycles into what it is today. The amazing community of MADSEN owners worldwide has become one of the greatest joys of our lives and work.
Our mission is simple: make incredible products for incredible people and get more families outside, making memories together on Bucket Bikes!

Your MADSEN will arrive fully assembled, with a complete tune-up and test ride from the mechanic at our shop prior to packaging. All you have to do is attach the front wheel and fender. You will also want to adjust the seat and handlebars to your liking. Tools needed are: 4mm, 5mm and 6mm hex wrenches. These are included with your bike. First install the fender: using the 4mm and 5mm hex wrenches, remove the 3 hex bolts on the front wheel fork - two 4mm bolts on opposite sides of the fork and one 5mm bolt behind the wheel lock. Put the fender through the fork and install the bolts. Make sure that the brake rotor/disk on the wheel is on the left side (same side as the brake caliper on the fork). Lift up the front of the bike and line up the fork dropouts above the wheel hub, at the same time making sure that the brake rotor/disk fits into the brake caliper. Carefully lower the forks onto the hub. Insert the thru-axle bolt through the right fork dropout, through the hub and into the left fork dropout. Tighten the thru-axle bolt with the 6mm hex wrench.

RIDING A MADSEN BUCKET BIKE

If you're comfortable riding a regular upright bicycle, you will feel right at home on your MADSEN. We have invested significant time into the design of our bikes to ensure stability, ease of use, safety, and reliability. Our customers will attest that it's a quick learning curve to ride the bucket bike with ease. Since the MADSEN is a little longer than a usual bike, just be mindful when rounding tight corners and turns. If you're a little hesitant, do a few practice rounds with an empty bucket. That said, most people have no problems at all riding (even at higher speeds) on the MADSEN!

Not necessarily. The bike has 9 gears, which help on any inclines. If your bucket is loaded with kids and you are carrying a lot of extra weight, a hill will be more of a challenge. Our custom MADSEN Electric Assist Kit can be added to your bike at any time, which makes any hill a breeze! Our custom e-kit is compatible for MADSEN bike models 2011 - current, to add to your current MADSEN bike. It is MOST compatible with 2019 and later models, as major upgrades to the brakes happened at this time to accommodate the electric option. (It can fit older 2009/2010 models with modifications.) With the e-assist, you will be able to add power when you want it. Your Electric bucket bike will allow you to easily cruise up hills with 4 kids, a pet and all of your gear in tow.

The MADSEN is designed to fit a very large spectrum of potential riders/sizes. The step-through frame and upright Dutch riding style of the MADSEN allow for riders of many heights to ride the bike comfortably. The seat is easily adjustable to fit the rider's leg length. Several 5-foot women have purchased the bike and ride comfortably. We also have a customer who is 6'10" with a 39" inseam, who rides the MADSEN comfortably. The height of the seat in its lowest position from seat to pedal is 28"/710mm. (There are a few other little tricks we can use in the rare case that the rider's legs are not tall enough - so let us know when you purchase!). The measurement of seat in its highest position to the pedal in its lowest position is 41".
The bucket width is no wider than the width of the handlebars, so the bucket will follow anywhere you feel comfortable fitting through with the handlebars, including standard doorways.

Any color of bucket will get hot if you leave the bike in the sun for an extended period of time. The black will get slightly more hot than the others if left in the sun. We haven’t noticed much a difference with a black bucket or lighter colored bucket while riding in the sun. The air moving is sufficient to keep it cooled down.

Many customers have had success with a 4-bike trailer-hitch bike rack, which will hold one MADSEN bike and one or two smaller bicycles (check your car's hitch and rack weight limits). You may also use a tandem bike roof rack, but we recommend you remove the bucket and put it inside the car to decrease weight on the roof. The bike also fits inside most SUV's and minivans, with the rear seats down.

Most bike racks are made to be pretty adaptable for carrying any bike. The 4-bike trailer-hitch rack (or bigger) works well because of the width of the bucket, making it farther away from the car. The racks that carry the bikes by the frame, rather than by the wheel are best as the Madsen wheel base is very long. We also recommend to use extra tie-down straps to secure the bike/handlebars/tires better than just the rack attachment, to prevent swaying and movement while driving. If you decide on a rack and want some peace of mind that it will work, please don't hesitate to send us the information on it and we will run it by our mechanics.

E-MADSEN FAQ

Hours of usage from the e-assist depends a lot on how you use it. It's like gas mileage - if you ride fast, with heavy cargo, and up a lot of hills, it won't last as long as if the terrain is flat or downhill and your cargo is light. It also depends on how much you pedal and how much wind-resistance is present. So it can get anywhere from three to ten hours, depending on all of these factors. Our customers have been very happy with the length of battery charge - and it’s safe to say if charged at night, you will be good to go on most all of your daily adventures. If you plan to bike many hours in one day, an extra battery on-hand is not a bad idea.
Yes, there is a 6V 500mA output connector from the controller which can be used to hook up after-market lights to the motor (the lights we sell are currently battery-powered)

The battery, motor, charger and wires are all individually UL compliant, or CE certified. We are currently working on UL certification specifically for the MADSEN E-bike as a whole. We are confident our E-bike system, including the battery, is safe. However, all lithium batteries have the potential of being dangerous. Always properly replace any damaged battery, use the correct charger and wires to stay safe. Safety is our top priority. We participate in the Call2Recycle program that allows MADSEN owners to recycle their batteries and dispose of them safely. Visit https://www.call2recycle.org to learn how to properly recycle your battery.
If you decide to purchase a Bafang kit from another vendor, we recommend that you order the BBS02 vs the BBSHD. Here are a few reasons why:

To take full advantage of the Max torque of the BBSHD you would need to pedal (cadence) 140 RPM. A comfortable pedaling cadence is 60-80 RPM. At a normal/comfortable pedaling cadence, the two motors are almost producing the same torque. Comparing the two motors side by side during actual riding conditions is quite a different thing than comparing the two motors on paper. The BBS02 and BBSHD have the same max-speed, although the BBSHD will accelerate faster. That faster acceleration will also eat up your battery more quickly. It can be compared to a car with a big souped-up V8 engine jammed in under its hood. The BBSHD is like that big V8. It will work, it will burn some rubber, use a lot of gas and you are sure to dominate your neighborhood drag race. But that same car works fine with a stock engine in it, getting you anywhere you would want to go while using less gas and putting less wear and tear on the drive train, brakes, tires, etc. The BBS02 is like the stock engine.

The MADSEN bucket bike is designed to be ridden at practical speeds by an average person who can produce somewhere between 100-250 watts. The BBS02 gives you 750 watts on top of that and the BBSHD 1000 watts.
The BBSHD 1000W is not street legal in many states: content/uploads/2017/12/Ebike-US-Reg-AppendixA-updated-11_2017.pdf
